title: Phoenix Dead of Night Ghost Hunt Walking Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join Phoenix Ghosts for our brand new late-night Ghost Hunt! This authentic ghost hunt invites you to explore the eerie streets and shadowy corners of Phoenix, revealing tales of the past that will send shivers down your spine. 

As you traverse the haunted sites, your expert guide will equip you with state-of-the-art ghost-hunting tools such as an EMF detector, a spirit box, and more, ensuring you’re fully prepared to connect with the otherworldly. Gather outside St. Mary's Basilica, where your adventure begins--from there, you will explore other areas such as the Icehouse and Hanny's. Please note that this is a walking tour, and while you will explore some of the most haunted locations in Phoenix, you will not enter any privately-owned buildings or properties. However, you will be standing on haunted ground throughout the entirety of the hunt. Explore at your own risk, and get ready to immerse yourself in the spirits of the city!
